evals.prompt: Write a complete, runnable HDevelop (.hdev) script that performs shape-based matching to find an IC on a PCB and reports each match's Row, Column, Angle and Score. The template is created from a saved image 'ic_template.png' with a rectangular ROI around the IC; the product polarity may flip between bright-on-dark and dark-on-bright. Save the trained model to 'ic_model.shm' so it can be reused. Prioritize robustness over speed, and explain your operator and parameter choices briefly.
evals.expected_output: An HDevelop script using read_image, gen_rectangle1, reduce_domain, create_shape_model (or the generic create_generic_shape_model/train/find), find_shape_model, with Metric set to tolerate polarity flip (ignore_global_polarity or ignore_local_polarity), reasonable MinScore ~0.5-0.8, Greediness, SubPixel least_squares, plus write_shape_model/read_shape_model reuse. Correct signatures and parameter ranges.

assertions.assertion: Uses read_image + gen_rectangle1 + reduce_domain for template ROI
Searches with find_shape_model / find_generic_shape_model and outputs Row,Column,Angle,Score
Tolerates polarity flip: contains ignore_global_polarity or ignore_local_polarity or ignore_color_polarity
Reuses the model: uses write_shape_model or read_shape_model
Uses a pixel-accurate SubPixel (least_squares or interpolation)
MinScore set in a sane 0.4-0.9 range

evals.prompt: Write a complete, runnable HDevelop (.hdev) script that measures the diameter of three circles with a 2D metrology model. The camera is already calibrated; CamParam is available in a variable. Each circle's approximate center and radius are known. For each circle, apply the metrology model to the image and print the measured diameter in millimeters (use the calibrated world-plane mapping). Include robust error handling and specify the key parameters (measure_length, measure_sigma, measure_threshold, measure_select).
evals.expected_output: An HDevelop script using create_metrology_model, add_metrology_object_circle_measure (3 circles), apply_metrology_model, get_metrology_object_result('result_type','all_param') to get Center/Radius, then image_points_to_world_plane or similar to convert to mm and compute diameter. Correct parameter defaults (measure_sigma ~1.0, measure_threshold ~30, measure_select 'all'). Headless-safe.

assertions.assertion: Converts to world/mm (image_points_to_world_plane or change_radial_distortion or world-plane map)
Sets metrology params measure_sigma(~1.0), measure_threshold(~30), measure_select('all'), measure_length via set_metrology_object_param

evals.prompt: Write a complete, runnable HDevelop (.hdev) script that reads a Bayer RAW uint2 image, demosaics it to color, limits processing to a circular ROI at the image center, converts to single-channel grayscale, and computes the mean and standard deviation of gray values inside that ROI. Print the results. Prefer high-quality interpolation and explain your choice.
evals.expected_output: An HDevelop script using read_image, cfa_to_rgb (or gen the Bayer type) with 'hamilton' as high-quality interpolation, convert_image_type to byte if needed, gen_circle ROI, reduce_domain, rgb1_to_gray, and intensity(Image, Region -> Mean, Deviation) or min_max_gray. Correct operator order and parameter choice (hamilton preferred over bilinear).

assertions.assertion: Demosaics with cfa_to_rgb using high-quality 'hamilton' interpolation
Creates circular ROI with gen_circle and reduces with reduce_domain
Computes Mean+Deviation with intensity(Image,Region->Mean,Deviation) or min_max_gray
